title: [Master] Different actions doesn't sync through and receive error sporadic (v3+WS)
symptom: Actions such as bolus from AAPS or AAPSClient do not sync through to AAPSClient, showing an error message in NSCV3-tab. The issue is sporadic and affects any action, including deletion of treatments, leading to wrong carb and IOB in AAPSClient.
cause: The issue was caused by a bug in the Nightscout server configuration at ns.10be.de, where the API3_MAX_LIMIT parameter was not being used correctly. The server code was patched to use env.API3_MAX_LIMIT.
fix: The fix was applied by the server provider (zehnBE) by patching lib/api3/generic/collection.js and lib/api3/index.js to use env.API3_MAX_LIMIT instead of the hardcoded value. After redeploying Nightscout master with the fix, the errors stopped. Additionally, a later comment suggests updating to Nightscout >= 15.0.7 as a fix.
evidence_quote: I have patched the lib/api3/generic/collection.js and lib/api3/index.js because it doesnt use the API3_MAX_LIMIT from the my.env on our side (it is in), so i rewrite it to env.API3_MAX_LIMIT.
